title: Composition of varying-coefficient raw pullbacks
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$, $h\prime\prime:Y\prime\prime\to S$ be scheme maps [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $b:Y\prime\prime\to Y\prime$, $d:Y\prime\prime\to Y$ satisfy $d=b;a$, $a;h=h\prime$, $b;h\prime=h\prime\prime$, and $d;h=h\prime\prime$. Let $F,F\prime,F\prime\prime$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on these schemes and let $\varphi_a:a^{-1}F\to F\prime$, $\varphi_b:b^{-1}F\prime\to F\prime\prime$, $\varphi_d:d^{-1}F\to F\prime\prime$. Assume that $\varphi_d$ agrees, after transport along $d=b;a$, with $C_{b,a,F};b^{-1}(\varphi_a);\varphi_b$, where $C$ is the canonical inverse-image composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. For every $p\in\mathbb N$, etale $U$ over $S$ and $z\in\mathrm{raw}(h,p,F)(U)$ [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison], raw pullback along $(d,\varphi_d)$ equals raw pullback along $(b,\varphi_b)$ of the raw pullback along $(a,\varphi_a)$. No diagram, cone, colimit, or geometric condition is assumed. Inverse images are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Normalize d, h′ and h″ using hd, wa and wb, and replace φd by the composite coefficient map using eq_of_heq hφ. Work first with an abstract Grothendieck abelian coefficient category and an arbitrary source sheaf M on S; specialize to AddCommGrpCat and the free sheaf on U at the end. These substitutions preserve every original hypothesis and conclusion; wd transports are proof-irrelevant.

The private singleComp lemma unfolds upperStarPlusComp and combines the already proved private exact-functor helpers Functor.plus_single_comp and Functor.plus_single_natIso from EtalePullbackSingleComp. This gives the compatibility of the derived composition with both single-functor comparisons. The sourceComp lemma uses naturality of the inverse single comparison, upperStarComp_assoc, and cancellation of the two invertible single comparisons to identify the source factors of the iterated raw map with the composite source factors followed by upperStarPlusComp.hom.

The targetComp lemma obtains shift compatibility of upperStarPlusComp by composing the already proved private Functor.plusNatIso_commShift and Functor.plusCompIso_commShift helpers of AbelianDerivedDirectImageTransitionShift. Naturality of commShiftIso moves both shifted coefficient factors; NatTrans.shift_app_comm combines the two shift comparisons. Naturality of the single comparison at φa and singleComp identify the remaining coefficient factors with single(upperStarComp.hom ≫ b*.map φa ≫ φb). This calculation uses no invertibility of φa or φb and works for all integer shifts.

The private rawGeneralComp lemma expands the five actual raw factors and distributes D(b*) over composition. Substitute sourceComp, use naturality of upperStarPlusComp.hom at z, and substitute targetComp. The resulting equality is exactly the composite raw formula. Specializing its coefficient category, degree, source free sheaf and class proves the original theorem without any new holes.

theorem abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback_composition {S Y Y' Y'' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (b : Y'' ⟶ Y') (d : Y'' ⟶ Y) (hd : d = b ≫ a)
    (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (h'' : Y'' ⟶ S)
    (wa : a ≫ h = h') (wb : b ≫ h' = h'') (wd : d ≫ h = h'') (p : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F'' : Sheaf Y''.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φa : ((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj F ⟶ F')
    (φb : ((b)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj F' ⟶ F'')
    (φd : ((d)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj F ⟶ F'')
    (hφ : HEq φd ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} b a).hom.app F ≫
      ((b)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map φa ≫ φb))
    (U : S.Etale) (z : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf h p F).obj (op U)) :
    abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback d h h'' wd p F F'' φd U z =
      abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback b h' h'' wb p F' F'' φb U
        (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback a h h' wa p F F' φa U z)
